div.div:
Retry keys + atomic receipts for booking, ticket and work acceptance.
Previously read versions for shared configuration edits.
standard / expensive budgets: one token per admitted attempt, including replays.
Deferred work has public operation status; acceptance is not confirmation.

Deferred work has public operation status; acceptance is not confirmation.

div.div:
MCP retains the user's authority; machine scripts use independent application grants.
Actual actor, requesting client and staff booking owner remain separate.
Desk allocated → taken only after the owner's personal check-in.
Room pending → confirmed only after Exchange accepts.
